rows.name: control: plain background
rows.value: background-color: rgb(1 2 3);

rows.name: control: one mix arm, other plain, on color
rows.value: color: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, hsl(26 22% 17%), black 50%), red 35%);

rows.name: both arms relative, literal origin
rows.value: background-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(from oklch(0.28 0.035 70) l c h / 0.1), oklch(from oklch(0.28 0.035 70) l c h / 0.14) 35%);

rows.name: both arms relative, var() origin
rows.value: background-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(from var(--ink) l c h / 0.1), oklch(from var(--ink) l c h / 0.14) 35%);

rows.name: arm mix + arm relative colour of a mix
rows.value: background-color: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.28 0.035 70 / 0.1) 100%, hsl(30 85% 96%)), oklch(from color-mix(in oklab, hsl(26 22% 17%), black 50%) l c h) 35%);

rows.name: arm relative of a mix + arm plain
rows.value: background-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(from color-mix(in oklab, hsl(26 22% 17%), black 50%) l c h), red 35%);

rows.name: both arms light-dark() holding mixes
rows.value: background-color: color-mix(in oklab, light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, hsl(26 22% 17%), black 50%), red), light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, oklch(0.28 0.035 70 / 0.1) 100%, hsl(30 85% 96%)), blue) 35%);

rows.name: registered <color> arms holding plain colours
rows.value: --ra: red; --rb: blue; background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ra), var(--rb) 35%);

rows.name: registered <color> arm holding a mix, other plain
rows.value: --ra: color-mix(in oklab, hsl(26 22% 17%), black 50%); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ra), red 35%);

rows.name: cured hover shape: one mix, relative var() ink, calc alpha and level
rows.value: --lvl: 1; --vq: 0.1; --vr: 0.14; background-color: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(from var(--ink) l c h / calc(0.65 * var(--vq) + 0.35 * var(--vr))) calc(var(--lvl) * 100%), hsl(30 85% 96%));

rows.name: cured blob shape: relative shadow colour, mix of it, drop-shadow
rows.value: --sc: oklab(from hsl(24 9% 4%) calc(l * 0.5) calc(a * 0.5) calc(b * 0.5)); --bsc: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sc) 22%, var(--sc)); filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--bsc) 20%, transparent));
